thread.title: Fun Prairie Pickleball Open returns June 5-7 at Wyndham Hills Park
thread.title_full: Fun Prairie Pickleball Open returns June 5-7 at Wyndham Hills Park

author: The Sconi
title: Fun Prairie Pickleball Open returns June 5-7 at Wyndham Hills Park
text:
The City of Sun Prairie Parks, Recreation and Forestry Department announced on April 27 that the Fun Prairie Pickleball Open will take place from June 5 to June 7 at Wyndham Hills Park. The event is open to players of all skill levels and aims to foster community involvement and friendly competition in the sport of pickleball.
Organizers say the tournament will include men’s, women’s, and mixed doubles divisions at several skill levels: 3.0, 3.5, and 4.0/4.5. A special Adult/Child event is scheduled for Friday, with traditional tournament play continuing over the weekend.
“This event is all about creating a fun and welcoming environment for everyone,” said Chad Shelton, Recreation Director. “Whether you’re brand new to the game or play regularly, the Fun Prairie Pickleball Open is a great opportunity to get on the court, meet others, and enjoy the experience.”
The format includes round robin pool play followed by medal rounds where games are played to either 11 or 15 points depending on division size. Top finishers will compete for gold, silver, and bronze medals; however, this event is not DUPR-rated.
Registration closes at midnight on May 25. Entry fees are $30 per event except for the Adult/Child division which costs $45; each registration also includes a $5 non-refundable service fee. Participants who register after May 25 are not guaranteed an event t-shirt due to ordering timelines.
According to organizers, the Fun Prairie Pickleball Open continues to grow as a highlight that brings together players from across the area in a relaxed setting focused on sportsmanship and community connection.
